info.title: Aurora Digital Banking Platform API
info.description: REST API specification for the Aurora Digital Banking Platform. This is the v1.0 baseline and is fully compliant with all 8 requirements in the SRS.

post.summary: Authenticate customer and issue a bound session token
post.description: Validates the customer identifier and passcode against the salted password hash and issues a signed JWT access token with configurable expiry. Returns a unique session_id and a device_binding_id linking the session to a registered device fingerprint for revocation and audit. Satisfies BNK-REQ-01.

passcode.description: Customer passcode, transmitted over TLS and verified against a salted hash

device_fingerprint.description: Stable fingerprint of the calling device, used for device binding

200.description: Authentication successful. Returns a signed JWT access token, its expiry, a unique session_id and the device_binding_id for this device.

session_id.description: Unique session identifier enabling revocation and audit trail generation

device_binding_id.description: Identifier binding this session to the registered device

post.description: Invalidates the supplied session_id so the JWT can no longer be used, and writes a session revocation entry to the audit trail. Satisfies BNK-REQ-01.

200.description: Session revoked and audit entry written.

get.summary: List all accounts owned by the authenticated customer
get.description: Returns every account belonging to the authenticated customer with its type, currency, available balance and ledger balance. Satisfies BNK-REQ-02.

200.description: Array of account records for the customer.

account_type.description: Account product type, for example savings or current

available_balance.description: Balance available to spend right now

ledger_balance.description: Posted ledger balance including uncleared items

get.summary: Retrieve a paginated transaction statement for one account
get.description: Returns the posted transaction lines for a single account over a date range, with pagination. Each line carries the transaction identifier, posting date, description, amount and running balance. Satisfies BNK-REQ-02.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Account to produce the statement for

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the statement period, ISO 8601 date

parameters.name: to_date
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the statement period, ISO 8601 date

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of transaction lines per page

running_balance.description: Account balance after this transaction posted

get.description: Returns every payment beneficiary registered by the authenticated customer together with its activation status and cooling period state. Satisfies BNK-REQ-03.

200.description: Array of registered beneficiaries with activation_status and cooling_period.

activation_status.description: Whether the beneficiary is active or still in cooling_period

post.description: Registers a new payment beneficiary. The new beneficiary enters a cooling_period state and cannot be used as a transfer destination until that period has elapsed. Satisfies BNK-REQ-03.

beneficiary_name.description: Name of the payee to register

201.description: Beneficiary registered. Returns the server-assigned beneficiary_id and an activation_status of cooling_period.

activation_status.description: Set to cooling_period until the beneficiary becomes usable

delete.description: Removes a payment beneficiary from the registered beneficiary list of the authenticated customer so it can no longer be selected as a transfer destination. Satisfies BNK-REQ-03.

200.description: Beneficiary deleted from the registered list.

post.summary: Submit a fund transfer with idempotent processing
post.description: Debits the source account and credits a registered beneficiary. The request must carry a unique client-provided idempotency_key so that a retried or duplicated submission is processed exactly once and can never create a second debit. The idempotency_key is echoed back in the confirmation response alongside the transfer_id, giving the client end-to-end proof of exactly-once processing. A request without an idempotency_key is rejected with a structured validation error. Satisfies BNK-REQ-04.

idempotency_key.description: Unique client-provided key guaranteeing the transfer is processed exactly once even if the request is retried

remarks.description: Free-text narrative shown on both statements

201.description: Transfer accepted. Returns the transfer_id and echoes the client-provided idempotency_key as proof that a retry did not create a duplicate debit.

transfer_id.description: Unique identifier of the accepted transfer

idempotency_key.description: The client-provided idempotency_key echoed back for end-to-end duplicate detection

post.description: Creates a recurring scheduled payment from a source account to a registered beneficiary at a chosen frequency. Returns the instruction_id and the computed next_execution_date. Satisfies BNK-REQ-05.

source_account_id.description: Account to debit on each execution

amount.description: Amount to transfer on each execution

frequency.description: Recurrence frequency: daily, weekly or monthly

start_date.description: ISO 8601 date of the first execution

end_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date after which the instruction stops

201.description: Standing instruction created. Returns instruction_id and next_execution_date.

instruction_id.description: Unique identifier of the standing instruction

next_execution_date.description: Computed date of the next scheduled execution

delete.description: Cancels a recurring standing instruction before its next scheduled execution so no further payments are made. Satisfies BNK-REQ-05.

200.description: Standing instruction cancelled before the next execution.

put.summary: Update the security controls on a debit card
put.description: Modifies the security controls on a card owned by the authenticated customer. Supports instantly freezing the card, setting per-transaction and daily spending limits, and toggling international, online and contactless usage. The response confirms the resulting state of every control attribute. Satisfies BNK-REQ-06.

parameters.name: card_id
parameters.description: Card whose controls are being modified

freeze.description: When true the card is instantly blocked for all usage

per_transaction_limit.description: Maximum permitted value of a single transaction

daily_limit.description: Maximum permitted total spend within one day

international_usage.description: Allow or block transactions outside the home country

online_usage.description: Allow or block card-not-present online transactions

contactless_usage.description: Allow or block contactless tap transactions

200.description: Confirmed resulting control state for freeze, per_transaction_limit, daily_limit, international_usage, online_usage and contactless_usage.

post.summary: Issue a step-up authentication challenge for a high-value operation
post.description: Issues a time-limited one-time passcode to the registered channel of the customer before a high-value operation may proceed. High-value operations are transfers above the configured threshold and first payments to a newly registered beneficiary. Satisfies BNK-REQ-07.

operation_type.description: The high-value operation requiring step-up authentication

operation_reference.description: Reference to the pending operation being protected

200.description: One-time passcode dispatched to the registered channel. Returns a challenge_id and the expiry of the time-limited code.

challenge_id.description: Identifier of the issued step-up challenge

expires_in.description: Lifetime of the one-time passcode in seconds

post.summary: Verify a step-up authentication code and authorise the operation
post.description: Validates the one-time passcode submitted by the customer against the issued challenge and returns a short-lived step_up_token that authorises the pending high-value operation to proceed. Satisfies BNK-REQ-07.

challenge_id.description: Identifier of the challenge being answered

code.description: One-time passcode submitted by the customer

200.description: Code verified. Returns a short-lived step_up_token authorising the high-value operation.

step_up_token.description: Short-lived token authorising the protected operation to proceed

post.summary: Raise a dispute against a settled transaction
post.description: Files a chargeback dispute against a settled transaction. Requires the transaction_id and a dispute_reason from the controlled vocabulary fraudulent, duplicate_charge, service_not_received or incorrect_amount, with an optional narrative. Returns the dispute_id, provisional credit status and expected resolution date. Satisfies BNK-REQ-08.

dispute_reason.description: Controlled vocabulary reason: fraudulent, duplicate_charge, service_not_received or incorrect_amount

narrative.description: Optional free-text description supplied by the customer

201.description: Dispute filed. Returns dispute_id, provisional_credit_status and expected_resolution_date.

dispute_id.description: Unique identifier of the filed dispute

provisional_credit_status.description: Whether provisional credit has been applied while the dispute is investigated

expected_resolution_date.description: ISO 8601 date by which the dispute is expected to be resolved

get.summary: Retrieve dispute status and resolution timeline
get.description: Returns the current status of a filed dispute together with its full event timeline so the customer can track resolution progress. Satisfies BNK-REQ-08.

200.description: Current dispute status and the full timeline of resolution events.

status_label.description: Human-readable current status of the dispute

timeline_events.description: Ordered resolution events with stage name and ISO 8601 timestamp

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the stage transition
